public.text: Signed transactions, national gateways, PKI, and sophisticated logging may not be immediately available in lower-resource environments. The section does not define a safe minimum transitional approach.
public.suggestedRevision: Specify baseline controls for early-stage exchange, including authenticated channels, endpoint registration, minimum audit data, access agreements, integrity checks, incident response, and a roadmap toward stronger cryptographic assurance.
